title: Energy ledger lab
caption: One kilogram on a ramp and a rough floor. The bar is the account.
draw: var g=9.8,m=1.0,h0=p.h0,mu=p.mu,Lr=4.0;var ramp=Math.sqrt(Lr*Lr+h0*h0),sinT=h0/ramp,cosT=Lr/ramp;var tt=t%7.0,dt=0.004,s=0,v=0,heat=0,n=Math.floor(tt/dt),i;for(i=0;i<n;i++){var a;if(s<ramp){a=g*sinT;}else{a=(v>0?-mu*g:0);}v=v+a*dt;if(s>=ramp&&v<0){v=0;}var ds=v*dt;if(s>=ramp){heat=heat+mu*m*g*ds;}s=s+ds;if(s>ramp+9.9){s=ramp+9.9;v=0;}}var x,y;if(s<ramp){x=s*cosT;y=h0-s*sinT;}else{x=Lr+(s-ramp);y=0;}var sc=Math.min((W-50)/14.2,(H*0.46)/5.2);var ox=26,gy=H*0.86;ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.strokeStyle=C.rule;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(ox,gy-h0*sc);ctx.lineTo(ox+Lr*sc,gy);ctx.lineTo(ox+14*sc,gy);ctx.stroke();ctx.font='12px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif';ctx.fillStyle=C.ink;ctx.strokeStyle=C.faint;ctx.lineWidth=1;if(mu>0){var j;for(j=0;j<24;j++){var hx=ox+Lr*sc+j*(10*sc/24);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(hx,gy+2);ctx.lineTo(hx+5,gy+8);ctx.stroke();}ctx.fillText('rough floor, mu = '+mu.toFixed(2),ox+Lr*sc+4,gy+22);}else{ctx.fillText('frictionless floor',ox+Lr*sc+4,gy+22);}ctx.strokeStyle=C.rule;ctx.setLineDash([3,4]);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(ox,gy-h0*sc);ctx.lineTo(ox+14*sc,gy-h0*sc);ctx.stroke();ctx.setLineDash([]);ctx.fillStyle=C.ink;ctx.fillText('start height h = '+h0.toFixed(1)+' m',ox+2,gy-h0*sc-6);ctx.fillStyle=C.figure;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(ox+x*sc,gy-y*sc-6,6,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();var KE=0.5*m*v*v,PE=m*g*y,tot=m*g*h0;var J';

title: Vertical loop lab
caption: Release height against loop radius. Below 2.5R the cart peels off.
draw: var g=9.8,R=p.R,h=p.h;var v0sq=2*g*h,tt=t%5.0,dt=0.003,phi=0,vsq=v0sq,lost=-1,n=Math.floor(tt/dt),i;for(i=0;i<n;i++){vsq=v0sq-2*g*R*(1-Math.cos(phi));if(vsq<=0){vsq=0;lost=phi;break;}if(vsq/R+g*Math.cos(phi)<0){lost=phi;break;}phi=phi+Math.sqrt(vsq)/R*dt;if(phi>2*Math.PI){phi=phi-2*Math.PI;}}var span=Math.max(h,2*R)+0.8;var sc=Math.min((H-46)/span,(W-70)/12);var gy=H-18,cx=W*0.64,cy=gy-R*sc;ctx.font='12px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif';ctx.strokeStyle=C.rule;ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(20,gy-h*sc);ctx.lineTo(W*0.30,gy);ctx.lineTo(W-16,gy);ctx.stroke();ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,cy,R*sc,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();ctx.strokeStyle=C.faint;ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.setLineDash([3,4]);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(20,gy-h*sc);ctx.lineTo(W-16,gy-h*sc);ctx.stroke();ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(20,gy-2.5*R*sc);ctx.lineTo(W-16,gy-2.5*R*sc);ctx.stroke();ctx.setLineDash([]);ctx.fillStyle=C.ink;ctx.fillText('release h = '+h.toFixed(1)+' m',22,gy-h*sc-5);ctx.fillText('2.5R = '+(2.5*R).toFixed(2)+' m',W-110,gy-2.5*R*sc-5);ctx.fillText('R = '+R.toFixed(2)+' m',cx+4,cy-2);ctx.strokeStyle=C.rule;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(cx,cy);ctx.lineTo(cx,cy-R*sc);ctx.stroke();var px=cx+R*sc*Math.sin(phi),py=gy-R*sc*(1-Math.cos(phi));ctx.fillStyle=(lost>=0?C.faint:C.figure);ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(px,py,6,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();if(lost>=0){ctx.fillStyle=C.accent;ctx.fillText('loses contact here',px+9,py-4);}var vtopsq=v0sq-4*g*R,vtop=(vtopsq>0?Math.sqrt(vtopsq):0),need=Math.sqrt(g*R);ctx.fillStyle=C.accent;ctx.fillText('top: needs v = sqrt(gR) = '+need.toFixed(2)+' m/s',cx-R*sc,cy-R*sc-8);out.note='v at top = '+vtop.toFixed(2)+' m/s, needs '+need.toFixed(2)+' m/s  ->  '+(h>=2.5*R?'completes the loop':'falls off the track')+'   (h = '+h.toFixed(1)+' m, 2.5R = '+(2.5*R).toFixed(2)+' m)';

title: Two-snapshot bookkeeping
caption: The same total energy, sorted into different pockets at each snapshot.
draw: ctx.font='12px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif';var lx=W*0.16,rx=W*0.62,bw=W*0.22,base=H*0.82,unit=(H*0.56)/100;ctx.fillStyle=C.ink;ctx.fillText('snapshot 1: released from rest',12,H*0.10);ctx.fillText('snapshot 2: at rest on the spring',rx-W*0.06,H*0.10);ctx.strokeStyle=C.rule;ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(12,base);ctx.lineTo(W-12,base);ctx.stroke();var Ug=60,Uk=0,K1=0;ctx.fillStyle=C.figure;ctx.fillRect(lx,base-Ug*unit,bw,Ug*unit);ctx.strokeStyle=C.rule;ctx.strokeRect(lx,base-Ug*unit,bw,Ug*unit);ctx.fillStyle=C.ink;ctx.fillText('U gravity',lx+4,base-Ug*unit+16);ctx.fillText('K = 0',lx+4,base+16);var Us=34,Q=26;ctx.fillStyle=C.accent;ctx.fillRect(rx,base-Us*unit,bw,Us*unit);ctx.strokeStyle=C.rule;ctx.strokeRect(rx,base-Us*unit,bw,Us*unit);ctx.fillStyle=C.faint;ctx.fillRect(rx,base-(Us+Q)*unit,bw,Q*unit);ctx.strokeStyle=C.rule;ctx.strokeRect(rx,base-(Us+Q)*unit,bw,Q*unit);ctx.fillStyle=C.ink;ctx.fillText('U spring',rx+4,base-Us*unit+16);ctx.fillText('heat from friction',rx+4,base-(Us+Q)*unit+16);ctx.fillText('K = 0',rx+4,base+16);ctx.strokeStyle=C.accent;ctx.lineWidth=2;var ay=base-Ug*unit-18,x1=lx+bw+8,x2=rx-8;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x1,ay);ctx.lineTo(x2,ay);ctx.stroke();ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x2,ay);ctx.lineTo(x2-8,ay-4);ctx.lineTo(x2-8,ay+4);ctx.closePath();ctx.fillStyle=C.accent;ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle=C.ink;ctx.fillText('same total, different pockets',x1+2,ay-7);ctx.fillText('the two columns must have equal height',12,H*0.955);
